entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6535499658122055552: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 3.6623 +/- 0.0147 mas (same row, RUWE 1.05): 273.05 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 9.950, -87.620 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.912 +/- 0.007 solar radii from Baştürk et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.541..714B/abstract). Mass 0.899 +/- 0.033 solar masses from Baştürk et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.541..714B/abstract). Temperature 5400 +/- 90 K from Bouma et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of WASP-4 b's parameter set from Bouma et al. 2019 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,400 K and log g 4.47 (u1 0.547, u2 0.202): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
